chains.trait: Enormous, independently rotating pinnae atop cranial domes
links: Dense humid air bends sound waves around tall grass obstacles
Nocturnal temperature inversions channel low-frequency pulses along the ground
Pack hunters rely on acoustic triangulation over visual contact in darkening savannas
Qu-gene locks preserve neural processing for complex sound mapping

skill.effect: Reveals stealth units within 25m and grants allies +2 evasion for 1 turn.

chains.weakness: High-pitched sonic disruptors scramble pinnae focus, breaking pack coordination.
observe: Ears swivel independently to track ground-level vibrations
Tracks align with dawn and dusk hunting shifts
Dust plumes avoid direct strikes, favoring flanking arcs

journal.en: They hear the grass breathe before they see it move.

plausibility.summary: Treat "triangulation" as enhanced localization and inter-aural timing in a ~0.3–3 kHz band suited to footfalls in grass, not bat-grade echolocation mapping; keep Pack Rally range modest (≤30 m) unless prey are actively vocalizing.
fixes: Treat "triangulation" as enhanced localization and inter-aural timing in a ~0.3–3 kHz band suited to footfalls in grass, not bat-grade echolocation mapping; keep Pack Rally range modest (≤30 m) unless prey are actively vocalizing.

analogues.organism: Domestic dog and gray wolf (Canis lupus) orientable pinnae with pronounced interaural level/time differences for terrestrial sound localization (Fay & Popper, comparative mammalian hearing).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: 0.88g gravity reduces skeletal stress on fine motor override
Savanna ecology favors ambush over prolonged chases across open loam
Qu-engineered tendon sheaths lock under tension to pierce herbivore hide
Pack coordination forces precise strike over blunt force

skill.effect: Targets limb joints for -40% movement speed on hit, ignores 50% armor.

chains.weakness: Claws lock upon extension; cannot reposition or grapple without retracting and risking a turn.
observe: Sunken nail beds snap outward like switchblades during ambush
Gait shows weight shifted forward onto metacarpals
Prey track parallel to wind, avoiding direct confrontations

journal.en: The knife doesn't cut; it waits.

plausibility.summary: Model thumbs as laterally hinged talons with partial retraction (felid-like sheaths on digit I), not a rigid lock that forbids all grasping—reserve full lock for the Engage finisher moment only.

relations.note: Predators triangulate prey footfalls with independently rotating pinnae; prey counter with silent digitigrade leaping across prairie grasses.
Predator pinnae detect Bone Crusher carrion-scent gland sprays, allowing them to intercept scavengers or avoid contaminated kills.
